fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-html, articleBody pulled from HTML div.entry-content since ld+json has no articleBody) carry headline/articleBody-style fields; latest-mode records (S2-rss, WordPress RSS feed at /feed/) carry title/link/content-style fields and already include full article text via content:encoded.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

slug.title: Slug
slug.description: URL slug of the article (trailing path segment).

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline, from the Article ld+json node (article mode only).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, paragraph-joined from

elements inside div.entry-content (article mode only).

author.title: Author
author.description: Byline name(s). Article mode: resolved from the ld+json Person node(s) referenced by the Article node's author field -- a real reporter name on staff pieces, or the wire service name (e.g. "AFP") on wire pieces. Latest mode: the RSS <dc:creator> value.

category.title: Category
category.description: Article mode: the full list of WordPress category names from ld+json articleSection (e.g. ["National","News","Top Story 1"]). Latest mode: the single RSS <category> value.

wordCount.title: Word count
wordCount.description: Word count reported by the ld+json Article node (article mode only).

datePublished.title: Date published
datePublished.description: ISO 8601 publish date from ld+json (article mode only).

dateModified.title: Date modified
dateModified.description: ISO 8601 last-modified date from ld+json (article mode only).

thumbnailUrl.title: Thumbnail URL
thumbnailUrl.description: Lead thumbnail image URL from ld+json (article mode only).

image.title: Image
image.description: Lead image (url/caption/width/height), resolved from the ld+json ImageObject node referenced by the Article node's image field (article mode only).

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text of a latest-mode RSS item.

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL from the RSS item (latest mode only).

pubDate.title: Publish date
pubDate.description: RFC-822 publish date string from the RSS item (latest mode only).

guid.title: GUID
guid.description: WordPress internal post GUID from the RSS item, e.g. "https://www.namibian.com.na/?p=967775" (latest mode only).

content.title: Content
content.description: Full article text, paragraph-joined from the RSS item's <content:encoded> HTML, with the trailing WordPress "The post ... appeared first on The Namibian." boilerplate paragraph stripped (latest mode only).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
